fieldRoleRules.title: Field rights
fieldRoleRules.description: Which fields a role may see and which it may change, in every status. The matrix beside this one says who may open a case of this type; this says what they read once it is open. A rule is declared here and enforced in OpenRegister, on every read path it has. dossiq filters nothing itself, so a field withheld here is absent from the search, the export and the API answer too, not just from the form.

statuses.title: In statuses
statuses.description: The statuses the rule holds in, as status type ids. Leave it empty and the rule holds in every status. A rule limited to statuses is enforced through the case lifecycle state of each of them, so a field read only while the case is with the intake is editable again once it moves on.
